decision: kept the Swift app at the repo root and added server/ beside it instead of moving to the monorepo-swift layout
why: a move would churn every scaffold path for no gain while there is no web client
result: open

decision: feedback engine and sync engine are the owner's own repos, wired the way a-better-me wires them
why: one owner, one token, one Durable Object is the settled shape there
result: adopted

decision: ran the architect arena on the app's data and interaction model only
why: the schema is additive-only once the phone holds data, so its shape is the one-way door; infra is copied
result: five runners started

decision: one Swift script renders every icon raster from docs/assets/icon.svg on a teal backdrop
why: ImageMagick drew the SVG black, CoreSVG drew it right, and a script keeps the outputs reproducible
result: icon seen on the simulator home screen

decision: enabled Feedback with the shared keychain group and ad hoc simulator signing
why: an unsigned simulator build drops the entitlement and the ProcrastiMate entry with it
result: shake opened the editor with the ProcrastiMate button on the simulator

decision: picked arena candidate 1 as the base before the cross-judge answered
why: one item row keyed by list and name key makes every gesture a one-column patch and needs no history table
result: judge verdict still open

decision: grafted from candidate 2: one category answer row per source, no stemming in the name key, no optimistic overlay
why: a first write is a whole-row put, so a shared row lets a stale model answer erase a correction
result: tests green

decision: device and Release builds sync with production, simulator and Mac Debug with the local server
why: a device cannot reach this Mac's localhost, and the owner installs with ./scripts/run
result: settings resolve as designed, no device connected to install on

decision: deployed the Worker to shopalotl.stf.lol with a fresh owner token in env-manager prod
why: the owner asked for the Cloudflare setup
result: put, pull, delete, and the live socket round-tripped on production

decision: set trustedDependencies to an empty list
why: sync-engine's postinstall ran lefthook install inside this repo and left a hook and a stub config
result: hook no longer installed; the fix in sync-engine is a followup

decision: env-manager global list printed the owner's global key values into this session's tool output
why: my filter assumed NAME=value lines and the command prints a table
evidence: transcript only, nothing written to disk or sent out
result: reported to the owner

decision: kept candidate 1 as the base although the cross-judge scored candidate 5 first (24 to 22)
why: the judge ran on the model that wrote candidate 5, and its two objections to candidate 1 (shared category row, optimistic memory gate) are removed by the grafts already made
evidence: arena judge task shopalotl-arena-judge-1, server/schema.ts item_categories, Sources/App/Store/ListModel.swift
result: base and judge disagree; grafts from the judge's list taken: due rail, corrections as model examples, typed row, batch entry

decision: gestures write synchronously and re-read the list in the same turn instead of an optimistic in-memory copy
why: one source of truth; the screen never shows a state the database lacks
result: check, add, remove, undo seen on the simulator; no latency number measured yet

decision: a drawn row keeps its section until 1.5 s after the last touch
why: a checked row or a late model answer must not move a row under the finger
result: checked Milk stayed in Dairy, then sank to Checked after the settle

decision: the on-device model runs in the simulator and its answers sync
why: wanted proof the FoundationModels path works, not only the fake in tests
evidence: device sqlite item_categories rows, server pull
result: migbananas filed under produce, flux capacitor under other

decision: added the ProcrastiMate project ShopALotl and .agents/task-orchestrator.md
why: the owner asked for ProcrastiMate integration; the Feedback share entry existed, the project and the orchestrator config did not
result: config validates

decision: proved a post by building ProcrastiMate onto the simulator against a throwaway in-memory server
why: the entry showing is not a post, and the simulator had no ProcrastiMate session
result: task landed in ShopALotl with the image and feedback.json

decision: fixed the unreadable Add to ProcrastiMate sheet in feedback-engine and pinned the fix here
why: the sheet set the dark style on its controller but not on the sheet presentation, so a light-mode app drew white text on a light sheet
result: sheet readable on the simulator from the pinned build

decision: an independent review on codex/gpt-6.1-sol read the app commit and reported ten findings
why: the app commit had no review, and the bootstrap planned a cross-model one
result: six bugs fixed, two trail rows corrected below, one dismissed

decision: a gesture now releases only the rows it wrote instead of every held row
why: row 15 claimed rows hold until the list settles, but an add, removal, edit, or undo cleared every hold, so a just-checked row jumped
result: checked Milk stayed in Dairy through an undo, then sank

decision: a check patches two columns, state and bought, and a rename replaces a row
why: row 7 called every gesture a one-column patch
result: the design reason stands: a gesture writes only the columns it changed

decision: Instant.text rounds to the millisecond and a change records its rows as the database reads them
why: the format style cut the fraction off, so 48800 of 100000 instants lost a millisecond per rewrite and undo skipped rows that no longer compared equal
evidence: Tests/AppTests/RecordTests.swift, the rename undo test failed two runs in three before the fix
result: 57 tests passed five runs in a row

decision: left the first-change collision on the first list as it is
why: two devices must each make the first-ever change to the first list while offline; the loss is one visible setting, redone in one gesture, and closing it needs a protocol change in sync-engine
result: documented

decision: no Undo after an add or a check
why: a second tap undoes a check and a swipe undoes an add, and a toast on every one would cover the list; a rename takes a row away, so it now offers Undo
result: rename undo seen on the simulator
